items.followUp: What is the purpose of the `href` attribute in an HTML tag?

rubric.why: Checks that the student explains what an HTML attribute provides.
rubric.description: States that an attribute provides extra information or properties for a tag.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for the purpose of an attribute.

rubric.why: Checks that the student knows how an attribute is written.
rubric.description: States that an attribute is written in the opening tag, usually as a name-value pair.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for its placement or form.

modelAnswer: Attributes provide extra information or properties about an HTML tag.
They are written in the opening tag as name-value pairs, for example, `href="page.html"`.
